title: Evaluation and Refinement of KF-STRIDE Into the Interview!
official: Evaluation and Refinement of KF-STRIDE Into the Interview!
summary: Examine the acceptability, usability, feasibility, and initial efficacy of KF-STRIDE 3.0, the data from which will serve as a basis for a future fully powered RCT
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants live in the United States of America
* Participants speak English Fluently and at a 4th grade reading level

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants have a history of significant psychiatric illness (like bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, or psychosis)
* Participants have a history of substance abuse
